sanjay: Heads up — model-onsmoke failed for bloom-lite-v2 during HF->Redwood conversion. Error summary: kv-cache reshape mismatch + tokenizer missing special token.

sanjay: Logs show hf config has "rope_scaling": {"alpha": 0.8, "factor": 1.5} and "num_key_value_heads": 40 but model file metadata expects 32. OOM when allocating kv cache. Also max_position_embeddings=2048 but tokenizer has no <|endoftext|> mapped, so chat template truncation is weird.

maya: I saw that too. Where did "sliding_window" go? HF config doesn't include it and our importer assumes sliding_window: true by default. That mismatch changes context window behavior.

aj: Repro steps I used: run importer then `pytest tests/convert_smoke.py::test_bloom_variants` -> fails in kv reshape. Quick local fix I tested: patch the converted config with jq to coerce fields. Example: 
```bash
cat config.json | jq '.rope_scaling |= {method: "scalar_adjust", alpha: .alpha // 1.0, factor: .factor // 1.0} | .num_key_value_heads |= (if . == null then (.num_attention_heads / 2 | floor) else . end) | .sliding_window |= (. // true)' > config-normalized.json
```
This got the smoke test past allocation stage (then hit tokenizer special token issue).

eva: For num_key_value_heads fallback we should be careful — some models tie num_kv to head groups differently. But a pragmatic rule is: if missing, use max(1, floor(num_attention_heads/2)) and then sanity-check: if model tensor shapes imply a different grouping emit a conversion warning and fallback to per-layer probe.

maya: tokenizers: the HF repo for this model used a custom special token set. Our conversion needs to copy `special_tokens_map.json` and also map `<|endoftext|>` -> Redwood's default end token. Otherwise chat templates truncate at wrong boundary.

aj: Proposed action items:
- add a conversion shim that normalizes rope_scaling variants (object vs nested fields vs null)
- default sliding_window = true but log the config delta
- add num_kv_heads fallback strategy + unit test for head-group mismatch
- ensure special_tokens_map is inspected and missing keys are injected from tokenizer.json

deploy-bot: smoke-run #9876 finished: 1 failure -> hf->redwood conversion sanity checks. See https://ci.redwood.internal/9876

sanjay: I'll open a quickfix PR with the jq normalization and a unit test that asserts the conversion produces a warning if any field was coerced. PR link when ready. @aj @eva can you review once I push? :thumbsup:

maya: thanks — adding test vector from the failing HF model to tests/fixtures/ so next runs catch it. :eyes:

aj: if we want to be conservative, also adjust the importer's tokenizer merging: prefer `special_tokens_map` from HF, then overlay Redwood defaults. avoids silent token loss.

sanjay: agreed. tagging this as P1 for onboarding pipeline until we ship handler. Will update thread with PR.
